name: StackedList
description: Mortar application stacked list: rows with optional leading media, a second column of meta at the row end (wrapping under the text when narrow), trailing controls, link rows with optional chevrons, and grouped sections with sticky headings.

props.label: string (accessible name; defaults to the title)
props.items: StackedListItem[] ({ id; title; description?; leading?; trailing?; meta?: ReactNode (second column inside the row; no links or buttons); href? }; rendered before groups)
props.chevrons: boolean (ends each row that has an href with a chevron)
props.title: ReactNode
props.headingLevel: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 (title level, default 2; group headings sit one level below the title, or at this level without one)

contract.usage: Import { StackedList } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
